rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for any person, especially in questions or free-choice statements.

example.jyutping: bin1 go3 soeng2 sik6 tong4 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when you mean any person in a more explicit or formal-sounding way.

example.english: Anybody can apply to join this programme.
